title: COR-297: Nightly Produce And Refresh Shared Hosted Anonymized Databases
description: Adds factory produce for remote DO scratch databases, publishes anonymized artifacts, refreshes the shared hosted anon DB, and wipes only objects owned by the connected role.

test_plan.description: Factory config and image are reviewable and ngramx docs point at the dedicated repo
steps: Open https://github.com/ngramx/postmaclone-factory and confirm postmaclone.yml lists hydra then earl-kendrick
Confirm publish paths use weathered-brook-anonymized-backups, not database-backups/all
Confirm credentials are op:// refs (read vs write items are separate)
Confirm ngramx README Large DBs section links the factory repo
On a lon1 host with Docker, OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN, and ~150GB free: docker compose run --rm factory and confirm hydra_anon.sql.gz plus latest.json land in the anonymized bucket

test_plan.description: Factory and docs use lon1 plus the live 1Password password field
steps: Confirm postmaclone.example.yml and factory postmaclone.yml use region lon1 and secret field password, not credential or ams3
From earl-kendrick-core with op signed in: php ../ngramx/bin/ngramx postmaclone --dry-run

test_plan.description: Factory produce --all only includes Earl Kendrick until a Hydra dump exists in Spaces
steps: Confirm factory postmaclone.yml has earl-kendrick and no hydra dataset
Confirm the newest database-backups/all/<date>/ listing has earl_kendrick_prod.sql.gz and no hydra_* object

test_plan.description: Local produce against DO scratch and shared anon for Earl Kendrick
steps: From postmaclone-factory with PATH including postgresql-client-17 and OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN set: php ../ngramx/bin/ngramx postmaclone produce --dataset earl-kendrick --config postmaclone.yml
Confirm the command publishes earl_kendrick_anon.sql.gz and latest.json to weathered-brook-anonymized-backups/earl-kendrick/
Connect as postmaclone_anon to earl_kendrick_core_prod_anon and confirm users.name/email are Faker values (example.com), not production
Connect as postmaclone_scratch to earl_kendrick_core_prod_scratch and confirm public has 0 tables owned by that role
